Container.Name: Forgefolio
Container.Description: A self-hosted 3D-print workshop: project-first model library, folder-aware kit imports, plated assemblies, gear lists, and Bambu color rendering — your files, your machine.
Container.Overview:
Forgefolio is a self-hosted 3D printing project and assembly manager. One container serves the whole app: a React frontend through nginx, and the FastAPI backend with SQLite persistence behind it.
Your data splits across two folders: the SQLite database (small — keep it in appdata on the cache pool) and the models library (every uploaded model file and thumbnail, companion documents, and the in-app backup snapshots the admin takes from Backup & Snapshots — big, and worth pointing at a share on the array if your cache pool is small). Both paths are editable below.
First run: create the administrator from the Unraid terminal with docker exec -it Forgefolio python -m app.cli create-admin --username YOUR_NAME (12+ character password at the hidden prompts; existing files are assigned to that first admin). Scripts and terminals without a TTY can pass the password on stdin instead: echo "YOUR_PASSWORD" | docker exec -i Forgefolio python -m app.cli create-admin --username YOUR_NAME --password-stdin
Sign-in note: for plain-HTTP LAN access leave COOKIE_SECURE at false (the default here). Turn it on only when the app is served behind HTTPS — Secure cookies are refused by browsers over plain HTTP, which reads as "sign-in doesn't work".

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The host port Unraid uses for the Forgefolio WebUI shortcut — the app's only port; nothing else needs publishing.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Forgefolio's database root — just the SQLite file (small). Keep it on a cache-backed share for speed.

Config.Name: Models library
Config.Description: Where your model library lives: model files, thumbnails, companion documents, and in-app backups. Defaults inside appdata; point it at a dedicated share on the array if your cache pool is small. Forgefolio takes ownership of this folder for the PUID account — use a share dedicated to the library.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The NAS account that owns Forgefolio's files. Unraid's default share user is 99 (nobody); check with 'id youruser' in the terminal.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group id that owns Forgefolio's files. Unraid's default share group is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: The file-creation mask for new files (022 = owner writes, everyone reads). Only change if your share setup needs it.

Config.Name: Upload directory
Config.Description: Where the app looks for its library inside the container — /models, the Models library path above. Leave it alone unless you also changed that path's container side.

Config.Name: Allowed extra origins
Config.Description: Additional browser origins for cross-origin setups only — the app's own address (whatever IP:port you browse it at) is always allowed. Leave empty for normal use; comma-separate extras (e.g. an external reverse-proxy address).

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Send Secure session cookies. Leave false for plain-HTTP LAN use; set true ONLY behind HTTPS (a reverse proxy), or browsers refuse the cookie and sign-in silently fails.

Config.Name: Upload size cap
Config.Description: Largest accepted upload in bytes — default 1 GiB, headroom for big kit ZIPs.
